# Habibi Ahmad Aziz

> Habibi Ahmad Aziz is a Fullstack Developer from Karawang, Indonesia. He builds modern web apps with Next.js, React, Laravel, and WordPress.

Habibi Ahmad Aziz (also known as Habibi Ahmad) is a Fullstack Developer based in Karawang, Jawa Barat, Indonesia. He graduated from SMKN 1 Karawang in Software Engineering (RPL) and works across frontend, backend, CMS, and web performance.

## Services

- [Web Design and Mobile-First UI](https://www.habibiahmada.dev/#services): Responsive interfaces from wireframes to production layouts
- [Frontend Development](https://www.habibiahmada.dev/#services): React, Next.js, and TypeScript UIs with clean reusable components
- [APIs and Databases](https://www.habibiahmada.dev/#services): REST APIs, relational databases, and auth systems
- [CMS and WordPress](https://www.habibiahmada.dev/#services): Custom themes, Elementor, and CMS platforms
- [Web Performance and SEO](https://www.habibiahmada.dev/#services): Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, and SEO-ready architecture
- [CI/CD and Deployment](https://www.habibiahmada.dev/#services): Automated pipelines and zero-downtime deploys
